stem: In recent years, the country's farmers have been extremely ____, contributing a major portion of the disturbances and protests against government policies.

Sinden notes that in the face of warnings about the perils of climate change, the need to agree on strategies for reducing greenhouse-gas emissions is increasingly urgent. The question of who should reduce emissions is not (i)____. Rather, according to Sinden, it is the question of who should bear the costs of these reductions that is (ii)____.
Many elected officials have (i)____ into believing that the new reforms represent a solution rather than (ii)____ of the problem. Unfortunately, such self-deception is not uncommon among politicians.

As theories, quantum field theory and theory of general relatively have been astonishingly (i)____ that no experiment yet has shown a crack in either of them, even though both of them (ii)____ wildly counterintuitive properties in physical reality. And yet even proponents note that the two theories are (iii)____, a fact that has disallowed theorists—at least so far—from incorporating both into a self-consistent theory of quantum gravity.
cols: deeply at odds with each other
colsZh: 与早期物理理论相似的

stem: Although torrential rains can sometimes be highly destructive, human survival generally proves much more ____ without rain than during periods of its overabundance.
The author’ s latest novel may ____ those who generally spurn her writing: its unvarnished prose has little in common with the labyrinthine interior explorations of her earlier work.

Many child development experts emphasize that the effects of a controlling parenting style are ____ individual differences in children’s personality: for instance, such effects are less pronounced among children who are temperamentally agreeable.
